literal_meaning: মাটিতে পা রাখা বা মাড়ানো (to step on the soil)
figurative_meaning_en: to set foot in or visit a place
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি কখনো এই গ্রামের মাটি মাড়িয়েছ?
example_sentences_in_english: I haven't set foot in this area for a long time.
Have you ever set foot in this village?
note: This idiom evokes a sense of connection to one's homeland or familiar places in Bengali culture.
